summary: The OccHealthInfluenzaEditAll control is a user interface component for managing influenza vaccination information within an enrollment system. It involves handling user interactions, server-side processing, and data binding related to influenza immunization status and season selection.
purpose: To manage influenza vaccination records for students, allowing for updating and displaying immunization status and corresponding seasons in a grid view.

workflows.name: Save Changes Workflow
steps: User modifies influenza status or season in the grid.
If modification occurs, mark the row as dirty.
Upon save command, update the database with new entries.
Redirect based on successful update or show warnings.

business_rules: If EnrollmentID is zero, hide certain UI elements when less than 14 rows exist.
Show or hide elements based on read-only status.
validations: Ensure UserSession is valid before processing.
Validate input parameters on data source selection.
calculations: Calculate the next year for influenza administration date.
conditions: If H1N1 is true, utilize specific logic for dropdown value selection.
system_behavior: Registers JavaScript variables for client-side processing.
Binds data to controls dynamically based on user interaction.
dependencies: GridView control to display and interact with data.
DataLayer.Enrollment for interfacing with enrollment records.
exceptions: Cancel data selection if UserSession is null.
